name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, plus selectable monochrome Gen 1 and Crystal-based Gen 2 backgrounds in Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen. Classic themes fully retile Pallet, Littleroot, Oldale and Route 101, with reviewed terrain and interiors elsewhere; other Gen 3 areas remain partially converted. Existing Gen 3 themes cover every Gen 1 map and all Johto backgrounds. Native-scale buildings, source entrances, collision, scripts and interactions are preserved.
